content:
AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 discounts of $120 are still live, and don't miss AirTag 2's all-time low starting from $20 each while supplies last. Apple has just debuted the new M6 Mac mini with preorders now available, and you can save over $500 trading in a mid-tier M4 Mac mini (more details here). Not technically a deal, but the new generation Apple Polishing Cloth is now on sale today for a much lower $9, and we also have the M5 Pro MacBook Pro (48GB) down to $400 off. Twelve South TimePorter band holder is now on sale for Prime members with free shipping under $21, details below.

One of the best Apple deals of the year: brand new 2026 AirTag 2 drops to as low as $20 each

While some Apple deals started to rise in price last week, brand new deals have arrived this week — the 2026 AirTag 2 is hitting its all-time low price at Amazon, down to $20 each.

Amazon also has the single AirTag 2 at $24 with Prime free shipping for an all-time low — this is the lowest price for the single version since launch.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (regular $29) — matches all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (regular $99) — brand new all-time low

But if you can use four, or find a friend to split the 4-pack with, that's just $20 each.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (regular $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (regular $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regular $129)

New generation M6 Mac mini preorder deals go live: save over $500 trading in M4

Apple has officially debuted the all-new M6 Mac mini with preorders now available, alongside new generation M5 Pro models and the new Mac Studio. Trade in a mid-tier M4 and you can land the M6 Mac mini for $374.

M6 Mac mini preorders now live

***Note: We'll continue hunting for preorder deals throughout the morning — expect a few solid trade-in offers and potentially gift card promotions going live as soon as today across platforms like Amazon, Best Buy, and beyond.

As the previous generation Mac mini all but disappears from retail channels, Apple has officially unveiled the brand new Mac mini. It's the first Mac to feature the M6 chip, sticks with the familiar form factor, comes standard with 512GB of RAM, and is now available for preorder on Apple's website:

  • M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB from $899
  • M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB from $1,699

M6 Mac mini trade-in deals

Apple is, of course, offering trade-in deals on the new Mac mini. For instance, trading in a mid-tier M4 Mac mini with 24GB of RAM and 512GB of storage takes $525 off the M6 Mac mini's price, bringing it down to just $374.

All the details on the new Mac mini and Mac Studio:

Tim Cook adds another feather to his legacy: brand new Apple Polishing Cloth now on sale for $9

Be sure to check in with 9to5Mac this morning, because Apple just unveiled the new generation M6 and M5 Ultra chips, as well as new versions of the Mac mini and Mac Studio powered by them. Exciting as all that is, Mr. Cook has decided to outdo himself — Apple has launched an entirely new generation of Polishing Cloth, priced at a mere $9.

AirPods deals winding down, grab AirPods Max 2 down $120 while supplies last

We've tracked plenty of great AirPods prices over the past week, but prices are starting to climb back up — make sure to lock in the $120 off AirPods Max 2 deal while supplies last.

Amazon also has the midnight black AirPods Max 2 at $429 for a summer sale price with free shipping. Other colors have already jumped back up to $449, so the midnight black deal should follow suit shortly.

The midnight black model is $120 off its regular $549 price; other colors are only $100 off.

This deal is primarily a leftover from last week's anniversary event and is expected to rise with the other colors soon.

This is the second-lowest price we've tracked for the 2026 new generation AirPods Max 2. They briefly dropped $150 during June Prime Day, but that was the only time they've gone that low.

This 48GB M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $400 off, but the configuration might be the better choice

Amazon has the Apple 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $500 off, but we also spotted B&H with this 48GB M5 Pro for $400 off at the same price.

The Amazon model comes with 24GB of RAM, 2TB of storage, and an upgraded 18-core/20-core spec at $2,699 with free shipping. That's $500 off the regular $3,199 price and one of the best M5 Pro deals in recent months.

But if double the RAM suits you better, B&H also has the same 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM, 1TB of storage, and 15-core/16-core specs for the same $2,699 with free shipping.

This one is regularly $3,099 and now $400 off.

So it's half the RAM and double the storage with stronger specs… or double the RAM and half the storage with base specs? Might not be the easiest call, but both are at sale prices right now.

Personally, I'm leaning toward more RAM, though 48GB does seem a little overkill, and the beefier core specs are pretty tempting too. I might go with the Amazon one myself.

If you're considering the 16-inch model, Apple's official refurbished store has some solid deals:

  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,549 (regular $2,999 new)
  • Space Black and Silver
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,059 (regular $3,599 new)

Alongside the new M6 Mac mini launch: Samsung 32-inch Smart Monitor back down to $180

Anker 7-in-1 Nano charging station with retractable USB-C and smart display down to $60 (75% off)

Alongside another clamp-style power strip deal earlier this morning, Anker's Amazon storefront has also dropped the 7-in-1 Nano charging station to $60 with free shipping.

Anker's official Amazon storefront is once again selling the 7-in-1 Nano charging station for $59.98 with free shipping.

Twelve South TimePorter Apple Watch band holder now at this year's low of $21 with Prime free shipping

Amazon is currently selling the Twelve South TimePorter band holder at this year's lowest price. This elegant wall-mounted holder tidily displays your Apple Watch bands, and you can grab one for under $21 with Prime free shipping.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Satechi translucent 4-in-1 USB-C travel hub with 4K HDMI down to $38
  • LG 32-inch 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor hits new low, $2,200 less than Studio Display XDR
  • Whisker offering $100 Labor Day discount, Litter-Robot bundles from $704
  • This ultra-thin UGREEN wallet tracker works with iPhone and Android, now down to $20 (all-time low)
  • Twelve South AirFly Pro wireless audio transmitter down to $40 at Amazon (black or white)

Tidy up your desk with Anker's clamp-style power strip, now down to $58

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low at Amazon with nearly 30% off (wired version discounted too)

As part of the late-summer sale event on Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home gear, Amazon has also dropped the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro to an all-time low and brought the wired version back to its Prime Day all-time low — both models are nearly 30% off their regular prices.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (regular $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (regular $250)

Although the brand has since launched the more affordable Ring Peephole Cam 2K at $100, we're focusing today on a few standout deals for the latest Pro series 4K models.

The Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro is back at its Prime Day all-time low, last seen during the late-June promotion. In fact, this is only the second time we've tracked this model dipping below $200.

The wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro is discounted for the first time, also hitting an all-time low at $180.

As mentioned above, both models are regularly $250 and now nearly 30% off, the best deals we've found to date.

The two are largely the same, featuring up to 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and Retinal 4K wide-angle video for clearer monitoring of your front porch. The wireless version comes with a Quick Release Ultra battery pack for easier installation (no wiring needed), while the wired version delivers "endless power, endless protection."

More details in our launch coverage from last September.

Anker's new SmartTrack Find My wallet card works with iOS or Android, down to $25 all-time low at Amazon

Anker recently launched its new SmartTrack Find My wallet card — the first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub — and it's now down to $25 with Prime free shipping, an all-time low at Amazon.

Anker's EufyHome Amazon storefront is now selling this new SmartTrack Card E40 (compatible with iOS or Android) for $24.99 with free shipping, available with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

It first landed on Amazon at $35 last month, got a slight $5 discount later that month, and is now seeing its first major price cut, hitting an all-time low at Amazon.

That's nearly 30% off and matches the best prices we've seen this year for similar wallet tracker cards.

I'm personally a huge fan of the Nomad Tracking Card — standard version starts at $35, Pro version with 16-month battery life (before needing a recharge) goes for $45 — but regardless of which you choose, I think everyone should keep one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave the house without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 comes with all the most important features, including wireless charging, and works with both Apple's Find My platform or Google's Find Hub. It's just 1.7mm thin, has a ringer volume of up to 80 decibels for locating it nearby, and of course integrates directly into the Find My and Find Hub apps so you can check its location on the map.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro is $220 off (matches Prime Day deal)

While Apple's Certified Refurbished store is my first recommendation for iPhone deals, Apple doesn't currently sell the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there, with that likely coming after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed stock is now back at Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro has consistently been the best option for grabbing a discounted unlocked model. Beyond saving a few hundred bucks, you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and "over 90% original battery life" — Amazon's non-"Premium" Renewed and Refurbished stock only comes with a 90-day warranty and less impressive battery life.

Both 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are back in stock with up to $220 off — the 512GB version is another $20 less than the previously mentioned price:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (regular $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (regular $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (regular $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (regular $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (regular $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (regular $1,299 new)

As covered in yesterday's Apple Refurbished feature, you can grab an iPhone 16 with a 1-year Apple warranty from $699, and a 1TB 16 Pro Max for just $1,269 — that's $330 less than a comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)
